segments.ja402:1.1: Vibbhantacitto kupitindriyosi, nettehi te vārigaṇā savanti;
segments.ja402:1.3: Kiṃ te naṭṭhaṃ kiṃ pana patthayāno, idhāgamā brahme tadiṅgha [brāhmaṇa iṅgha (sī. syā.)] brūhi.
segments.ja402:2.1: Miyyetha bhariyā vajato mamajja, agacchato maraṇamāha yakkho;
segments.ja402:2.3: Etena dukkhena pavedhitosmi, akkhāhi me senaka etamatthaṃ.
segments.ja402:3.1: Bahūni ṭhānāni vicintayitvā, yamettha vakkhāmi tadeva saccaṃ;
segments.ja402:3.3: Maññāmi te brāhmaṇa sattubhastaṃ, ajānato kaṇhasappo paviṭṭho.
segments.ja402:4.1: Ādāya daṇḍaṃ parisumbha bhastaṃ, passeḷamūgaṃ uragaṃ dujivhaṃ [dijivhaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja402:4.3: Chindajja kaṅkhaṃ vicikicchitāni, bhujaṅgamaṃ passa pamuñca bhastaṃ.
segments.ja402:5.1: Saṃviggarūpo parisāya majjhe, so brāhmaṇo sattubhastaṃ pamuñci;
segments.ja402:5.3: Atha nikkhami urago uggatejo, āsīviso sappo phaṇaṃ karitvā.
segments.ja402:6.1: Suladdhalābhā janakassa rañño, yo passatī senakaṃ sādhupaññaṃ;
segments.ja402:6.3: Vivaṭṭachaddo [vivattacchaddo (sī.), vivaṭṭacchado (syā.), vivaṭṭacchaddā (pī.)] nusi sabbadassī, ñāṇaṃ nu te brāhmaṇa bhiṃsarūpaṃ.
segments.ja402:7.1: Imāni me sattasatāni atthi, gaṇhāhi sabbāni dadāmi tuyhaṃ;
segments.ja402:7.3: Tayā hi me jīvitamajja laddhaṃ, athopi bhariyāya makāsi sotthiṃ.
segments.ja402:8.1: Na paṇḍitā vetanamādiyanti, citrāhi gāthāhi subhāsitāhi;
segments.ja402:8.3: Itopi te brahme dadantu vittaṃ, ādāya tvaṃ gaccha sakaṃ niketanti.
